label: Nuclear envelope dynamics and nuclear pore transport
reason: NE breakdown/reformation, NPC assembly, ESCRT-III sealing and nucleocytoplasmic cargo traffic through the pore form one nuclear-envelope theme.

label: Myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
reason: Every member concerns skeletal myoblast commitment, migration, proliferation, fusion or myotube differentiation.

label: Sulfur and selenium amino acid metabolism
reason: Transsulfuration, cysteine/H2S/sulfide metabolism, selenium handling via the same enzymes, PLP cofactor and Moco for sulfite oxidase; one sulfur-metabolism theme.

label: Epithelial junctions and basement membrane anchorage
reason: Cell-cell junctions (cadherin, desmosome) and cell-matrix anchorage (hemidesmosome, laminin, integrin, collagen) linked as the adhesive architecture of epithelia/cardiac tissue.

label: Mitochondrial respiration and oxidative/nitrosative stress
reason: Regulation of OXPHOS/respiration and responses to ROS/NO, ferroptosis and H2O2-induced apoptosis linked by mitochondria as ROS source and redox target.

label: Sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and fertilization
reason: All members cover sperm motility, acrosome, zona binding/penetration, gamete fusion and egg activation.

label: Hematopoietic lineage differentiation (myeloid/erythroid/megakaryocytic)
reason: Erythroid, granulocytic, monocytic and megakaryocytic differentiation, RUNX1 and CSF signalling dominate; a few RUNX1 non-blood targets and stray modules are a small minority.

label: Chaperonin (CCT/TRiC) mediated protein folding
reason: Prefoldin/CCT folding of tubulin, actin and G-beta plus general folding/refolding; RHOBTB2 and proteasome assembly are minor oddities.

label: ER membrane shaping and phospholipid transfer/flipping
reason: ER tubular network organization and intermembrane lipid transfer/flippase-scramblase activity linked by membrane lipid homeostasis at ER contact sites.

label: Skeletal muscle fiber development and contraction
reason: Myofibril/sarcomere assembly, DGC, NMJ and contraction form one muscle theme; ECM proteoglycans and generic terms are a small minority.

label: Adrenal and gonadal steroid hormone biosynthesis
reason: Gluco-/mineralocorticoid and androgen synthesis with CYP enzyme deficiency disorders; one steroidogenesis theme.

label: Ubiquitin-proteasome protein quality control
reason: Ubiquitin chain types, E3s/DUBs, proteasome, ERAD, N-/C-degron and misfolded-protein responses all belong to ubiquitin-dependent degradation.

label: Integrin focal adhesion and cell spreading
reason: Integrin/syndecan/fibronectin adhesion, FAK/MET-tensin signalling, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly driving cell spreading and migration.

label: Hematopoiesis and thymic T cell development
reason: Bone marrow progenitor homeostasis and thymocyte proliferation/selection/apoptosis are both blood-cell development in primary lymphoid organs.

label: Heart morphogenesis: chambers, septa and valves
reason: Heart tube, second heart field, trabeculation, septation, cushion EMT and valve formation; one cardiogenesis theme.

label: Glycogen metabolism and glucose-6-phosphate handling
reason: Glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycogen storage diseases, G6P transport/hydrolysis, glucokinase and gluconeogenesis form one hepatic/muscle glucose-storage theme.

label: Coagulation, fibrinolysis and platelet activation
reason: Clotting factors and their defects, VWF, contact pathway, fibrinolysis and platelet adhesion/activation all form hemostasis.

label: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and extravasation
reason: Integrin activation, PECAM1, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation all describe leukocyte adhesion and transmigration.

label: Mitochondrial/peroxisomal intermediary metabolism and cofactors
reason: Amino acid catabolism, fatty acid beta-oxidation, TCA intermediates and vitamin/cofactor metabolism (with inborn errors) linked by mitochondrial-peroxisomal oxidative metabolism.

label: p53-mediated senescence and DNA-damage apoptosis
reason: TP53 transcriptional programmes, p16/p14ARF senescence evasion, SASP/SAHF and intrinsic apoptosis via PUMA/NOXA form one stress-response axis.

label: NF-kB activation in lymphocyte signalling
reason: TCR/BCR downstream NF-kB, non-canonical NIK pathway, CD27/TNFRSF and IKBKB-deficiency all describe lymphocyte NF-kB signalling.

label: Viral integration, latency and retroelement silencing
reason: Retroviral integration/PIC import and host silencing of viral/endogenous retroelements (HUSH, KRAB-ZFP, APOBEC3G) linked by host control of integrated foreign DNA.

label: Lipoyl-dependent dehydrogenases and PLP serine-glycine metabolism
reason: Lipoylated PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes and the glycine cleavage system plus vitamin B6/serine metabolism linked via the PLP- and lipoate-dependent glycine cleavage/SHMT axis.

label: Nuclear RNA export
reason: mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunit export through the nuclear pore dominate; a few transcription/mitochondrial-import terms are minor.

label: Early heart field specification and morphogenesis
reason: Second heart field, heart tube, cardiomyoblast differentiation and ventricle morphogenesis form one cardiogenesis theme.

label: cAMP/PKA second messenger signalling
reason: Adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP synthesis/degradation, PKA/DARPP-32 and CREB phosphorylation form one cAMP signalling theme.

label: Dopamine/neuropeptide GPCR signalling and behaviour
reason: Dopamine and neuropeptide receptor signalling linked to the behaviours they control (reward, drug response, sleep/wake, mating, feeding, stress).

label: Striated muscle growth, regeneration and adaptation
reason: Myoblast/satellite cell regulation, muscle hypertrophy/atrophy and cardiomyocyte proliferation/adaptation form one muscle growth theme.

label: Heart morphogenesis: chambers, septa and valves
reason: All members are cardiac chamber, septum, cushion EMT and valve development.

label: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and organic acidurias
reason: Leucine/isoleucine/valine catabolism, biotin-dependent carboxylases and their deficiency disorders; 2-HG/toxic-metabolite repair are minor.

label: Hemostasis plus eicosanoid and vitamin K metabolism
reason: Coagulation/platelet activation and eicosanoid/SPM lipid mediator and vitamin K pathways linked by platelet thromboxane signalling and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors.

label: Striated muscle sarcomere and sarcolemmal architecture
reason: Sarcomere assembly/contraction, DGC, T-tubules, caveolae, costameric ILK complex and intercalated disc junctions all build the striated muscle cell.

label: rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis
reason: RNA Pol I initiation/elongation/termination, rDNA chromatin control, pre-rRNA cleavage and MYC targets form one ribosome biogenesis theme.

label: Neural control of locomotion and sensorimotor behaviour
reason: Locomotor, reflex and proprioceptive behaviours with glycinergic transmission and cerebellar development; amygdala and the RNA-binding module are a small minority.

label: Death receptor (Fas/TRAIL) extrinsic apoptosis in T cells
reason: Caspase-8 activation, c-FLIP, BID cleavage, Fas/TRAIL signalling and T cell activation-induced death form one extrinsic apoptosis theme.

label: Hormonal regulation of glucose homeostasis
reason: Insulin, glucagon/PKA, adiponectin and AMPK regulation of glucose uptake, gluconeogenesis and glycogen form one metabolic-hormone theme.

label: Hox axial patterning and neural crest/pharyngeal derivatives
reason: Hox/somite axial patterning and neural crest, craniofacial, ear and pharyngeal organ development linked by Hox/TFAP2 codes patterning neural crest and pharyngeal arches.

label: Leukotriene, lipoxin and resolvin lipid mediator biosynthesis
reason: Nearly all members are eicosanoid and specialized pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis and catabolism.

label: Germline development, fertilization and zygotic reprogramming
reason: Spermatogenesis/fertilization and germline-zygote epigenetic programmes (piRNA transposon silencing, imprinting, MZT) linked as the germline cycle.

label: Extracellular matrix and basement membrane assembly
reason: Collagen synthesis/crosslinking, laminin, fibronectin, elastic fibres, basement membrane and integrin/hemidesmosome anchoring; arylsulfatase is a lone outlier.
